decision_rule.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta (CELL-1 minus PLAN) is ABOVE ZERO and the CI95 lower bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -0.9943 (owner decision 99, the TRAIN lock: a gain is proven, not merely non-inferior)
decision_rule.DELTA_CONSUMPTION: item S3-4s: the per-node delta-consumption table -- how many deltas each node was supplied per row, which value_ids were supplied, and the saves and harms on the rows that received each one -- is a PRIMARY deliverable, reported whatever the verdict, and is what decides which deltas survive into store version 2.
decision_rule.FRONTIER: owner decision 75: the frontier row (official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows) is reported on every verdict and placed beside the registered rows.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: a MEASURED loss on either guard (owner decision 25, Method B: a CI95 upper bound below zero, or a point estimate beyond the margin); width alone is NEUTRAL, never HARMFUL
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: both guards are non-inferior -- the SLU CI95 lower bound exceeds -1.2485 and the intent CI95 lower bound exceeds -0.9943 -- without a proven SLU gain
decision_rule.PER_SCENARIO_HARM_BOUND: owner decision 17: per-scenario intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, with net harmed rows per scenario and any scenario of five or more flagged. A breach is a diagnostic beside the verdict, never a gate.
decision_rule.REPLICATION: an ADMITTED result is replicated on the SAME roster before any DEV, Fold B or test read (the owner iteration rule; no DEV read is authorised by this package).
decision_rule.TWIN: ATTRIBUTION, never admission. The twin arm is read with the same estimator against the same sealed PLAN comparator. A gain the twin reproduces within the plan's own null is FORM (the store's shape and token volume), not content, and the verdict says so and claims no content effect. A gain the twin does not reproduce is attributed to the deltas' content, with the twin delta reported beside it.
decision_rule.comparator: the sealed PLAN arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1 (official 63.6304 / 82.2222); nothing is re-flown
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict

execution_route: No standalone fit run. core.preparation_fit.build_native_contact_fit_gate fits each realised native request inside the same flight, under the same lease. coordinate-fit must NOT be run, or this row is double-charged.

modules.base: the locked v2.0 SLURP default plan, exactly as the sealed PLAN arm flew it (configs/baseline/slurp-native-default-plan-lock-baseline-v1.json): the complete native episode with the review loop on, the shared controller and FlightRuntime path, no phase_tools on any role, Solver-only answer authority, the three-candidate contract, the max512 np4 resident geometry, the slot-contracts v2 / intent-boundaries v1 / train-exemplars k=20 stores, saea-deliver-normalise-v3 at delivery, and items E13 and E22 declared. Nothing of it moves.
modules.factor: the same one factor as the arm, with the store pinned to the DERANGEMENT TWIN release (knowledge/slurp/semantic/stage3-deltas-twin-v1r/): the same 379 statements, the same node distribution and the same token count, with the candidate-bound nodes' associated_facet_ids and the unconditional list's TARGET fields deranged under seed 20260922 as WHOLE attachment tuples (scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_twin.py; the token count and the per-row facet-count multiset are held exactly, and 16 of 379 rows landed on an equal facet set by arithmetic because v1r's vocabulary is 39 distinct intents over 379 rows). The twin is the FORM control: a gain it reproduces is form, not content.
modules.purpose: Stage-3 S3-6 CELL-1 as amended by S3-4s (owner decisions 83, 99, 101, 106): the locked v2.0 plan plus the NODE-TARGETED stage3-deltas store as ONE factor on TRAIN Fold A, comparator the sealed PLAN arm at the plan's own null (h_SLU 1.2485 / h_intent 0.9943), twin arm as the form control. PRIMARY DELIVERABLES: (1) the official paired read against the sealed PLAN arm under the decision-99 TRAIN lock rule; (2) the per-scenario effect x prefilled-token frontier table in both natural-mixture and equal-stratum weightings, deciding which deltas survive into version 2; (3) the per-node delta-consumption table (S3-4s): which deltas were supplied, per scenario and per node, and the saves and harms on the rows that received each delta; (4) the twin contrast, which decides attribution, never admission.
modules.second_declared_key_not_a_factor: native_episode.react_exhaustion_policy = continue-without-answer (item E22) and finite_completion_policy = deliver-latest-or-abstain (item E13): failure-mode declarations the locked plan already carries, required of every live SLURP native cell by scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py. Neither renders a request byte.
modules.zero_added_contacts: the added store supplies text to requests the plan already makes, so the role graph and therefore the 11-contact per-row ceiling are cell PLAN's unchanged

prepared_phase_supply.note: Item E16: a prepared artifact is evidence only for the implementation that produced it, so each of the four flown cells prepares its OWN first-phase Perception supply under its OWN run id at the readiness flip. core.flight.repin.ensure_artifact_pinned runs core.flight.cli prepare-supply (model-free, zero model / tokenizer / encoder / scorer / server contacts), writes the pin into the baseline fragment and inserts the matching 'preparation' readiness requirement. The committed baselines therefore carry NO prepared_phase_supply key at all -- the cell-P0 form (scripts/flights/batch/derive_plan_cell_registration.py drops it for exactly this reason). A PENDING_ string in its place is NOT a valid registration: core.flight.repin.ArtifactPin.from_mapping refuses it ('malformed artifact pin') before the preparation step can run, which is the defect this registration repaired.
